title: Where the Crawdads Sing
author: Delia Owens
summary: Kya Clark is abandoned by her family and grows up alone in the North Carolina marshes, known to locals as the Marsh Girl. Years later, when a young man is found dead, she becomes the main suspect.
readIf: you like a nature-filled, atmospheric story that blends a coming-of-age tale with a courtroom mystery.
skipIf: you want a tough, twisty crime plot, since this is more a love story and a portrait of a place.

pairings.reason: Another Southern story of a girl finding her way after loss, with a warmer, kinder tone.
Another novel about a girl raised in a wild landscape and shaped by a troubled family.
A gentler, funnier story of nature, loneliness and an unexpected friendship.
